gen-dafont-groovy-gf-noto-sans-thai-loop: Round, wiry, a little goofy. Groovy closes its bowls in a line that never swells, while Noto Sans Thai Looped stands tall and leaves its curve ends open; a larger heading size would help that show.
gen-dafont-groovy-gf-noto-sans-tifinagh: Wire-drawn funk up top, with Groovy's c nearly shut, then Noto Sans Tifinagh rounds things out with open, inviting letters. Its inflated bowls fill a line, so paragraphs feel plump and easy.
gen-dafont-groovy-gf-noto-sans-tirhuta: Noto Sans Tirhuta brings a dominant x-height and terminals cut back to leave big gaps, set against Groovy's nearly closed c. Shrink the heading and that funky closed shape gets lost.
gen-dafont-groovy-gf-noto-sans-ugaritic: Noto Sans Ugaritic keeps its lowercase nearly as tall as its capitals. Those open letter mouths run against Groovy's nearly sealed, loosely spaced shapes, and that open-versus-closed tension is the pair's real hook.
gen-dafont-groovy-gf-noto-sans-vai: Friendly, a bit funky, and drawn like a plotter pen. Groovy is best at grabbing a glance, while Noto Sans Vai is best at making words sit as solid blocks, with generous space at curve ends.
gen-dafont-groovy-gf-noto-sans-vithkuqi: Smooth curves that never thin out lead the way in Groovy, set above Noto Sans Vithkuqi. And what stands out most is how small the step from capital to lowercase feels in the body, with throats left open.
gen-dafont-groovy-gf-noto-sans-wancho: Noto Sans Wancho reads like thick chalk pressed hard, its hulking lowercase leaving a wide gap at the e. And Groovy, with bowls drawn at stem thickness, feels like a friendly wire sitting beside it.
gen-dafont-groovy-gf-noto-sans-warang-ci: Groovy leaves its horizontals no thinner than its verticals, and its c is nearly sealed. Noto Sans Warang Citi then fills the page with solid word blocks and wide channels into each counter.
gen-dafont-groovy-gf-noto-sans-yi: A narrow slit where the c almost closes marks Groovy, while Noto Sans Yi keeps its rounds unsealed like an unlatched hook. Deep lowercase midsections make long lines feel sturdy and unhurried.
gen-dafont-groovy-gf-noto-sans-zanabazar: Approachable all round: Groovy bends like a paperclip with no swelling, while Noto Sans Zanabazar Square soars on a tall x-height. Wide gaps keep its small sizes crisp beneath that wiry heading.
